description: Embedded communication decomposed. CAN frame structure + arbitration, CAN FD enhancements, EtherCAT distributed clock + on-the-fly processing, TSN time-aware shaper, OPC UA pub-sub, automotive Ethernet (100BASE-T1).

sub_mechanisms.name: CAN_frame_arbitration
sub_mechanisms.definition: Standard frame: 11-bit ID + 8 bytes data. Lower ID = higher priority. Non-destructive arbitration.
sub_mechanisms.why: Multi-master, no central controller. Priority ID wins arbitration. Standard automotive (1986 Bosch).

sub_mechanisms.name: CAN_FD_flexible_data
sub_mechanisms.definition: Extended frame: 64 bytes data, faster phase (5 Mbps). Backward compatible.
sub_mechanisms.why: Classic CAN 8 bytes limiting. CAN FD increases throughput for modern automotive. Adopted by VW, BMW, etc.

sub_mechanisms.name: CAN_bit_stuffing
sub_mechanisms.definition: Insert opposite bit after 5 same bits. Avoids unintended dominant runs.
sub_mechanisms.why: Synchronisation: edges required for clock recovery. Cost: variable frame length. Standard CAN encoding.

sub_mechanisms.name: EtherCAT_summation_frame
sub_mechanisms.definition: Master sends frame around bus loop. Each slave reads + writes its data on-the-fly.
sub_mechanisms.why: Microsecond cycle times. No store-and-forward delays. Foundation of EtherCAT's speed. Beckhoff's invention.

sub_mechanisms.name: EtherCAT_distributed_clock
sub_mechanisms.definition: Hardware-synchronised clocks across slaves. ns-level precision.
sub_mechanisms.why: Coordinated motion control. Multiple servo drives synchronised. Foundation of multi-axis machines.

sub_mechanisms.name: TSN_time_aware_shaper
sub_mechanisms.definition: IEEE 802.1Qbv. Gate control list opens/closes traffic queues at scheduled times.
sub_mechanisms.why: Deterministic Ethernet. RT traffic in scheduled window; best-effort otherwise. Standard for industrial TSN.

sub_mechanisms.name: TSN_frame_preemption
sub_mechanisms.definition: 802.1Qbu. Express frame preempts ongoing best-effort frame transmission.
sub_mechanisms.why: Bound latency for high-priority. Without: large frame transmits = blocks small high-priority frame. With: preempted, resumed.

sub_mechanisms.name: TSN_PTP_synchronization
sub_mechanisms.definition: Precision Time Protocol. Hardware timestamping. ns-level clock sync over Ethernet.
sub_mechanisms.why: All TSN depends on shared time. PTP grandmaster + boundary clocks distribute. Foundation of TSN determinism.

sub_mechanisms.name: OPC_UA_information_model
sub_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical object model. Variables, methods, events. Companion specs for domains.
sub_mechanisms.why: Self-describing. Client browses server, learns semantics. Foundation of industrial interoperability.

sub_mechanisms.name: OPC_UA_pub_sub
sub_mechanisms.definition: Publisher → message broker → subscribers. Alternative to OPC UA client-server.
sub_mechanisms.why: Scales better. Multicast UDP. Combined with TSN for RT. Standard for Industry 4.0 data pipelines.

sub_mechanisms.name: automotive_ethernet_100BASE_T1
sub_mechanisms.definition: IEEE 802.3bw. 100 Mbps over single twisted pair. Lower weight + cost than 100BASE-TX.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern car Ethernet. Replaces specialised buses for high-bandwidth (cameras, radar). Foundation of vehicle networking.

sub_mechanisms.name: SOME_IP
sub_mechanisms.definition: Scalable service-Oriented MiddlewarE over IP. AUTOSAR service-oriented for adaptive.
sub_mechanisms.why: Service-oriented architecture for vehicles. Standardised RPC + pub-sub. Used in adaptive AUTOSAR.

derivation_rules.name: CAN_priority_arbitration_deterministic
derivation_rules.why: Bit-wise non-destructive arbitration. Lower ID = more dominant bits early = wins arbitration. Critical message ID = low. Predictable latency.

derivation_rules.name: EtherCAT_microsecond_cycle_via_on_the_fly_processing
derivation_rules.why: Classic: each switch buffers full frame. EtherCAT: each slave reads/writes its slot as frame passes. Massive latency reduction. Foundation of industrial motion control.

derivation_rules.name: TSN_frame_preemption_bounds_RT_latency
if: high-priority frame arrives during long best-effort transmission
derivation_rules.why: Without: wait for full max-size frame (~120μs at 100 Mbps). With: preempt + resume. RT frames meet deadline.

derivation_rules.name: PTP_required_for_TSN_determinism
then: all nodes need synchronised clocks via PTP
derivation_rules.why: Scheduled = at specific time. Time must be shared. Hardware timestamping + boundary clocks → ns sync. Foundation of all TSN.

derivation_rules.name: automotive_Ethernet_replaces_specialised_buses
derivation_rules.why: CAN: 1-5 Mbps. Ethernet: 100M-10G. Camera needs 100s of Mbps. Single 100BASE-T1 pair handles. Industry direction.
